content.text: Skip to main content You are hereHomeCourt Information Court Holidays Federal Holidays The Court is closed on the following federal holidays each year. More information can be found at OPM.gov (link is external). Holiday Date New Year’s Day January 1st* Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr. Third Monday of January Washington’s Birthday Third Monday of February Memorial Day Last Monday of May Juneteenth National Independence Day June 19th* Independence Day July 4th* Labor Day First Monday of September Columbus Day Second Monday of October Veterans Day November 11th* Thanksgiving Day Fourth Thursday of November Christmas Day December 25th* * If a fixed holiday falls on a Saturday, it is observed on the preceding Friday. If a fixed holiday falls on a Sunday, it is observed on the following Monday.
